cards.ex: We're planning a loft conversion to add an extra bedroom.
cards.exUz: Qo'shimcha yotoq xonasi qo'shish uchun chordoqni qayta qurishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyning chordoq qismini yashash uchun moslash, xonaga aylantirish.

cards.ex: The Burj Khalifa is an architectural marvel, showcasing modern engineering.
cards.exUz: Burj Xalifa - zamonaviy muhandislikni namoyish etuvchi arxitektura mo'jizasi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining go'zalligi va murakkabligi bilan hayratga soluvchi bino.

cards.ex: I love the layout of this apartment; it feels very spacious.
cards.exUz: Menga bu kvartiraning rejalashtirilishi yoqadi; u juda keng ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Xonalar, mebellar va boshqa elementlarning binoda joylashuvi.

cards.ex: This old house is quite drafty in the winter, even with the heating on.
cards.exUz: Bu eski uy qishda isitish yoqilgan bo'lsa ham, juda shamollaydigan.
cards.uzDef: Soğ havo kiradigan joy, deraza yoki eshik yopilmasa.

cards.ex: The building was in disrepair, with broken windows and crumbling walls.
cards.exUz: Binoning derazalari singan va devorlari qulab tushgan holda ta'mirga muhtoj edi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ahvolda, buzilgan yoki e'tiborsiz qoldirilgan holat.

cards.ex: The balcony overlooks a beautiful garden.
cards.exUz: Balkon go'zal bog'ga qarab turadi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqoridan qarab turmoq, manzara ochilmoq.

cards.ex: The house retains many original period details, like the fireplace and cornices.
cards.exUz: Uy ko'plab original davr detallarini saqlab qolgan, masalan, kamin va kornizlar.
cards.uzDef: Eski binolarda o'sha davrga xos arxitektura elementlari.

cards.ex: We were looking for a spacious apartment with plenty of natural light.
cards.exUz: Biz ko'p tabiiy yorug'likka ega keng kvartira qidirayotgan edik.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmli, erkinlik hissini beruvchi joy.

cards.ex: These ancient dwellings provide valuable insights into past civilizations.
cards.exUz: Bu qadimiy turar joylar o'tmish sivilizatsiyalari haqida qimmatli ma'lumotlar beradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar yashaydigan joylar, uylar.

cards.ex: The building has a beautiful stone facade that gives it a grand appearance.
cards.exUz: Binoning go'zal tosh fasadi bor, bu unga ajoyib ko'rinish beradi.
cards.uzDef: Toshdan qurilgan binoning old tomoni, tashqi ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: With land prices so high, many cities are choosing to build upwards.
cards.exUz: Yer narxlari juda yuqori bo'lganligi sababli, ko'plab shaharlar yuqoriga qurishni tanlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer maydoni cheklangan bo'lsa, bino qavatlarini ko'paytirish.

cards.ex: They had to bring down the old factory because it was unsafe.
cards.exUz: Ular eski fabrikni xavfsiz bo'lmagani uchun buzishga majbur bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Binoni vayron qilmoq, pastga tushurmoq.

cards.ex: We had to make do with a smaller apartment until we could afford a bigger one.
cards.exUz: Biz kattaroq kvartiraga pulimiz yetgunga qadar kichikroq kvartira bilan qanoatlanishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud narsalar bilan kifoyalanmoq, vaqtincha yechim topmoq.

cards.ex: They're going to knock down the old warehouse and build a new shopping center.
cards.exUz: Ular eski omborni buzib tashlab, yangi savdo markazini qurmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Binoni yoki devorni buzish, yer bilan tekislash.

cards.ex: The living space in this apartment is surprisingly generous.
cards.exUz: Bu kvartiradagi yashash maydoni hayratlanarli darajada katta.
cards.uzDef: Uyning yashash uchun ishlatiladigan qismi.

cards.ex: They used reclaimed materials to build a unique and sustainable home.
cards.exUz: Ular noyob va barqaror uy qurish uchun qayta ishlangan materiallardan foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Eski binolardan olingan va qayta ishlatilgan materiallar.

cards.ex: Sustainability is a key consideration in modern architecture.
cards.exUz: Barqarorlik zamonaviy arxitekturada asosiy omil hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ekologik muvozanatni saqlash, kelajak avlodlar uchun resurslarni tejash.

cards.ex: The new paint was just window dressing; the house still needs major repairs.
cards.exUz: Yangi bo'yoq shunchaki ko'zbo'yamachilik edi; uy hali ham katta ta'mirga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Fasadni chiroyli ko'rsatish, asl holatni yashirish.

cards.ex: This is a well-maintained building with excellent facilities.
cards.exUz: Bu ajoyib jihozlarga ega yaxshi saqlangan bino.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda ta'mirlangan va yaxshi holatda saqlangan.

cards.ex: The residents enjoy spending time in the communal garden.
cards.exUz: Aholi umumiy bog'da vaqt o'tkazishdan zavqlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta odamlar birgalikda foydalanadigan bog'.

cards.ex: Housing affordability is a major issue in many cities.
cards.exUz: Uy-joyning arzonligi ko'plab shaharlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Pulga to'g'ri kelishi, qimmat bo'lmasligi.

cards.ex: The high ceilings make the room feel much larger and more airy.
cards.exUz: Baland shiftlar xonani ancha katta va havodor his qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Xonalarda yuqori shiftlar, havo kirishiga imkon beradi.

cards.ex: Urban sprawl is leading to increased traffic congestion and environmental problems.
cards.exUz: Shahar kengayishi transport tirbandligining oshishiga va atrof-muhit muammolariga olib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shahar hududlarining tartibsiz ravishda kengayishi.

cards.ex: The old factory was redeveloped into apartments on a brownfield site.
cards.exUz: Eski fabrika ifloslangan ishlab chiqarish maydonida kvartiralarga aylantirildi.
cards.uzDef: Ilgari sanoatda ishlatilgan va ifloslangan yer uchastkasi.

cards.ex: This is a quiet residential area, away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
cards.exUz: Bu shahar markazining shovqinidan uzoqda joylashgan tinch turar joy hududi.
cards.uzDef: Uylar va kvartiralar joylashgan shahar qismi.

cards.ex: The building survey revealed some serious structural defects.
cards.exUz: Binoni tekshirish jiddiy konstruktiv nuqsonlarni aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Binoning mustahkamligiga ta'sir qiluvchi kamchiliklar.

cards.ex: A modest dwelling provided shelter from the storm.
cards.exUz: Oddiy uy-joy bo'ronlardan panoh berdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar yashaydigan bino, uy.

cards.ex: They're planning to put up a new apartment block on that corner.
cards.exUz: Ular bu burchakda yangi ko'p qavatli uy qurishni rejalashtirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Binoni yoki inshootni qurish.

cards.ex: The area is known for its high-end boutiques and restaurants.
cards.exUz: Hudud o'zining yuqori darajadagi butiklari va restoranlari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Qimmatbaho va sifatli mahsulot yoki xizmat.

cards.ex: The new extension was designed in keeping with the original style of the house.
cards.exUz: Yangi qo'shimcha uyning asl uslubiga mos ravishda loyihalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Uslubga yoki atrofdagi muhitga mos ravishda.
